stem.name: Snow
stem.description: A bright white stem with soft grey shadows, crisp as the first untouched snow of morning.

stem.name: Silver
stem.description: A soft metallic grey for a friend who notices what the clouds leave behind.

stem.name: Ash
stem.description: A quiet ash-grey stem with a soft charcoal shadow.

stem.name: Porcelain
stem.description: Pale and composed, with the calm of an empty cup waiting to be filled.

stem.name: Vanilla
stem.description: A warm vanilla stem for the sort of friend who remembers how you take your tea.

stem.name: Peach
stem.description: Soft peach warmth with a fondness for the sunny side of any path.

stem.name: Clay
stem.description: Earthy red, like a favourite plant pot still warm from the windowsill.

stem.name: Cocoa
stem.description: A deep brown stem for days best measured in pages and warm drinks.

stem.name: Wine
stem.description: A deep burgundy stem with the quiet richness of red wine in low light.

stem.name: Lemon
stem.description: Bright yellow for voyages through the inner ocean. Periscope up; the garden is far above.

stem.name: Honey
stem.description: Golden warmth, as if the afternoon decided to stay for dinner.

stem.name: Tangerine
stem.description: A flash of orange that makes an ordinary afternoon feel freshly opened.

stem.name: Scarlet
stem.description: A bright red presence. Some days deserve a little announcement.

stem.name: Strawberry
stem.description: A blush-pink stem with a quiet affection for very small celebrations.

stem.name: Orchid
stem.description: A pink-purple note left somewhere you will be pleased to find it.

stem.name: Lavender
stem.description: The colour of a pause between the last errand and the first evening star.

stem.name: Violet
stem.description: A deep violet stem, dressed for the small theatre of everyday life.

stem.name: Slate
stem.description: An inky stem for conversations that get interesting after everyone checks the time.

stem.name: Electric Blue
stem.description: Electric ultramarine runs from head to toe, shaded like a small current waiting to move.

stem.name: Cobalt
stem.description: Cobalt blue with its thoughts somewhere beyond the next bend.

stem.name: Cyan
stem.description: Clear cyan and deep-water blue settle into a cool stem with the calm pull of an underwater current.

stem.name: Sky Blue
stem.description: A little patch of blue brought down to where the roots live.

stem.name: Teal
stem.description: A clear turquoise daydream, halfway between a river and a well-kept secret.

stem.name: Mint
stem.description: A cool green stem that looks ready for the first walk of the morning.

stem.name: Jade
stem.description: Rich green, happiest where the light comes through leaves.

stem.name: Moss
stem.description: Soft green, slow mornings, and absolutely no hurry to become anything else.

stem.name: Lime
stem.description: A green so awake it may have already put the kettle on.

stem.name: X-Ray
stem.description: An ivory crown and fine golden bones turn a dark little stem into a luminous anatomical keepsake.

stem.name: Nuclear Core
stem.description: A white-hot stem ringed in yellow, orange, and red, designed to complete Cold War.

stem.name: Frankenstem
stem.description: Blush, cocoa and lemon patches are stitched into one unlikely little body.

stem.name: Cocoa Stomp
stem.description: A long dark cocoa boot planted firmly for walks that intend to make an entrance.

stem.name: Blush Stomp
stem.description: A long blush-pink boot with soft highlights and the confidence to take the scenic route.

cap.name: Wonderland
cap.description: White spots on scarlet mark the entrance, where size is negotiable and the path has other plans.

cap.name: Magic Hour
cap.description: Apricot and amber hold the last light like a film still. Even the ordinary looks enchanted.

cap.name: Jelly Weather
cap.description: A jelly-bright cap with a delightfully flexible opinion about looking sensible.

cap.name: Lagoon
cap.description: Turquoise light ripples across a sheltered blue world with its own tide and no clocks.

cap.name: King Crimson
cap.description: A gold crown presides over a crimson spotted court, keeping time in an unusual signature.

cap.name: Truffle Club
cap.description: A dark, textured cap for someone who knows the best places are often unmarked.

cap.name: Ladybird Landing
cap.description: Bright red and spotted, offering a cheerful landing place for a passing thought.

cap.name: Love Letter
cap.description: A cap covered in small reminders that affection need not be particularly complicated.

cap.name: Proof of Love
cap.description: Pink hearts offer proof, signed with feeling and committed permanently to the chain.

cap.name: Touch the Grass
cap.description: A flowered green wizard hat. Log off, go barefoot, touch the grass.

cap.name: Pistachio Cloud
cap.description: A soft green cloud with unusually good reasons to remain close to the ground.

cap.name: Mr. Moss
cap.description: A brown woodland cap beneath a green toupee, smelling faintly of rain and knowing every root.

cap.name: Garden Party
cap.description: Daisies crowd a green cap. Flower power, open invitations, and music drift over the fence.

cap.name: Daisy Bell
cap.description: A blue daisy humming the song HAL learned to sing.

cap.name: Sun Dust
cap.description: Golden straw holds a long festival afternoon. Dust hangs in the light after the final chord.

cap.name: Blue Lines
cap.description: Cyan channels cross midnight blue while a slow bassline travels beneath the surface.

cap.name: Technicolor Dream
cap.description: Hot pink and gold keep dancing for 14 psychedelic hours.

cap.name: Under the Sea
cap.description: Shells, starfish, and a coral reef with Sebastian somewhere in the chorus.

cap.name: Mescalito
cap.description: A flowering cactus guides the hour when shadows lengthen and the desert starts asking questions.

cap.name: Sunday Shag
cap.description: A pale shaggy cap with the pleasing air of having cancelled its appointments.

cap.name: Rare Frog
cap.description: A wide-eyed green frog, fresh from the pond and already part of the lore.

cap.name: Deep Water
cap.description: A deep teal cap with the quiet composure of a pool in the shade.

cap.name: Sky of Blue
cap.description: Cobalt overhead, paired with a sea of green.

cap.name: Velvet Morning
cap.description: Ultraviolet fades into plum as some velvet morning slips onto the radio.

cap.name: Sea of Green
cap.description: Emerald below, paired with a sky of blue.

cap.name: Porcelain
cap.description: A pale porcelain cap, smooth and self-possessed. Delicate in appearance, quietly ready for whatever strange ceremony begins next.

cap.name: Emerald City
cap.description: Deep green towers form a polished skyline at the end of a winding road.

cap.name: Red Shift
cap.description: Crimson light stretches across a darkening curve, signalling something fast beyond the garden.

cap.name: Blue Hour
cap.description: A cobalt cap lingering in the hour when everything becomes a little more cinematic.

cap.name: Pink
cap.description: Pink, plainly and completely. One good colour can be an entire point of view.

cap.name: Chestnut
cap.description: Rich chestnut brown with the warmth of polished wood, fallen leaves, and the first story told after dark.

cap.name: Saffron
cap.description: A bright saffron cap, carrying the colour of spice, robes, and late sunlight distilled into one small button.

cap.name: Chanterelle
cap.description: Golden folds flare like a woodland trumpet. A chanterelle with enough ruffle to turn foraging into an occasion.

cap.name: Amber King
cap.description: Layered amber folds form a radiant crown for the forest floor's glowing monarch.

cap.name: Morel
cap.description: A dark honeycomb tower, intricate and practical in the strange logic of morels.

cap.name: Bee Beautiful
cap.description: Warm honeycomb cells make a roof fit for wildflowers, daydreams, and every small worker keeping the garden alive.

cap.name: Parajanov
cap.description: Pomegranate colours arranged like folklore inside a film frame.

cap.name: Purple Rain
cap.description: Violet folds open under an electric purple downpour.

cap.name: Tropical Overture
cap.description: Bright fan-like folds, as if the woodland orchestra had booked a warmer venue.

cap.name: Lavender Haze
cap.description: Lilac folds drift between the last song of night and the first morning light.

cap.name: Bifrost
cap.description: Layered rainbow bands bridge the forest and elsewhere. Even the smallest traveller deserves a mythic crossing.

cap.name: Croissant
cap.description: A buttery crescent with crisp golden layers. Breakfast has achieved its final and most convincing form.

cap.name: Baker Street
cap.description: Tweed, clues, and a little London fog. The smallest detail is already telling a much larger story.

cap.name: Beatnik
cap.description: A midnight beret with one red spark, ready for basement poetry, black coffee, and a beautifully unreasonable idea.

cap.name: Aurora Loop
cap.description: Lime and violet circle like northern light caught in an endless electric groove.

cap.name: Electric Carousel
cap.description: A turning burst of colour with the music still in its head.

cap.name: Spin Art
cap.description: Rainbow colour caught at full rotation. The paint keeps moving long after the turntable has stopped.

cap.name: Peppermint Twist
cap.description: Red and white spiral onto a sugar-bright dance floor. One turn sets the whole room moving.

cap.name: Vertigo
cap.description: A hypnotic loop bends depth and direction until the ground feels optional. Look twice.

cap.name: WIP
cap.description: A candy-coloured stack still becoming itself. Every strange little masterpiece spends some time as a work in progress.

cap.name: White Stripes
cap.description: Red and white bands keep the arrangement spare, loud, and exact. Two colours are plenty.

cap.name: One Love
cap.description: Red, gold, and green crown dark locks while bass rolls through the roots. Everyone fits the rhythm.

cap.name: Rainbow Flow
cap.description: Bands of colour move in one continuous current, finding the path of least resistance and making it luminous.

cap.name: Airwaves
cap.description: Neon ribbons cross the dark like signals from an unknown station. Tune carefully; the garden is broadcasting tonight.

cap.name: Soft Frequencies
cap.description: Pastel bands for a world that could occasionally turn its volume down.

cap.name: Pastel Perspective
cap.description: Pastel planes shift with every angle. A softer perspective can still rearrange the whole picture.

cap.name: Synergy
cap.description: Candy-coloured strands gather into something brighter than any one of them alone. Cooperation, with excellent fringe.

cap.name: Electric Avenue
cap.description: Ion-bright ribbons turn the street into a current. Follow the voltage; the long way home is fully illuminated.

cap.name: Bubblegum
cap.description: Pink and orchid ribbons stretch into a sweet, elastic daydream with no intention of growing up.

cap.name: Copper Mirage
cap.description: Copper and mint cross paths in a pattern that rewards a second look.

cap.name: Hendrix Chord
cap.description: Black and white keys land on E7#9. Electricity follows.

cap.name: Neon Nocturne
cap.description: A bright little tune for the part of the evening that refuses to end.

cap.name: Shell Music
cap.description: A shell-like pattern keeping an imaginary sea close to hand.

cap.name: Sound Check
cap.description: Bright bars ready for the moment someone finally says the sound is good.

cap.name: Visible Music
cap.description: A resonance-inspired pattern, imagining what a held note might leave behind.

cap.name: DJ
cap.description: A vinyl pulse reads the room, finds the hidden groove, and brings the beat back.

cap.name: Afterparty
cap.description: A bright lattice holds the dance floor's last lights. Morning has not informed the music.

cap.name: Picnic
cap.description: A mosaic blanket spread beneath a mirrorball sky. Bring fruit, good company, and shoes suitable for unexpected dancing.

cap.name: Pollock
cap.description: Colour crosses colour in a rush of action painting.

cap.name: Malevich
cap.description: Geometry floats free in a small suprematist sky.

cap.name: Xcopystein
cap.description: Lilac stitches bring a handmade glitch back to life: part patchwork, part afterimage, fully onchain.

cap.name: Mondrian
cap.description: Nested colour blocks turn a quilt into a comfortable little De Stijl interior.

cap.name: Check, Please
cap.description: A classic checkerboard for someone who considers every square a possible dance floor.

cap.name: Fractal
cap.description: One small rule repeats until a society of triangles appears. Order keeps discovering wilder versions of itself.

cap.name: Truchet
cap.description: Curved tiles keep changing partners until every route becomes interesting.

cap.name: Blue Quartz
cap.description: Ice-blue geometry locks into a crystalline patchwork. Cool, precise, and quietly charged beneath the surface.

cap.name: String Theory
cap.description: Dark and pearl-bright strands braid through hidden dimensions. Pull one thread and the whole little universe answers.

cap.name: Tiffany
cap.description: Luminous currents cross like leaded glass under water. Every wave finds its place in the window.

cap.name: Neverland
cap.description: Contour lines map an island beyond ordinary coordinates. Second star, then follow the impossible path.

cap.name: Matisse
cap.description: Bright cut-outs float freely across a pale field.

cap.name: Sheldon Lee Copper
cap.description: Copper and mint arrange themselves with theoretical precision. One path stays irrational.

cap.name: Lava Lamp
cap.description: Magma colours rise and fold in liquid time. It is 1969, and the future looks molten.

cap.name: Liquid Sky
cap.description: Lagoon currents pour through a sky that forgot which side of the horizon it belongs to.

cap.name: Great Wave
cap.description: Cobalt and gold curl into Hokusai's great wave, small enough to wear.

cap.name: Pink Mint
cap.description: Jade and rose trace candy-cool lines between a garden path and a newly minted world.

cap.name: Winter Atlas
cap.description: Pale contours mapping a quiet place between ice and light.

cap.name: Wave Function
cap.description: Pale paths move through midnight ink as several possible journeys at once. Observation may change the destination.

cap.name: Block Party
cap.description: Bright cells gather wall to wall, each bringing its own colour to the neighbourhood. Geometry has invited everyone.

cap.name: Electric Lace
cap.description: A fine, bright mesh with the unexpected delicacy of a very loud idea.

cap.name: Velvet Witch
cap.description: A pointed velvet cap for practical magic: listening well, making tea, turning up.

cap.name: Moonchild
cap.description: A moonlit cap for the child of night who receives strange transmissions and answers in silver.

cap.name: Area 51
cap.description: A polished saucer has crossed the restricted perimeter. Visitors are welcome; official confirmation remains unavailable.

cap.name: Emerald Eye
cap.description: An emerald eye watches from above, catching the details reality hoped would pass unnoticed.

cap.name: Sapphire Eye
cap.description: A sapphire eye keeps watch over the blue hour. Quiet, lucid, and impossible to distract.

cap.name: Prism Wizard
cap.description: A pointed cap whose favourite spell is finding another colour in ordinary light.

cap.name: Rainbow
cap.description: Pastel light opens into the full spectrum.

cap.name: The Great Fromage
cap.description: A cheese-inspired wizard cap. A distinguished career in making people smile.

cap.name: Medusa
cap.description: An opal jellyfish drifts overhead, its living ribbons turning the sea toward mythology.

cap.name: Cold War
cap.description: A nuclear mushroom cloud burns in yellow, orange, and red. History stays hot.

cap.name: Punks Not Dead
cap.description: A skull-marked cap broadcasts three chords from the crypt. The volume rises; punks are not dead.

cap.name: Good Chemistry
cap.description: A cap for experiments, observations, and the pleasure of a question well asked.

cap.name: Aladdin Sane
cap.description: A red-and-blue lightning bolt from Bowie's glam years.

cap.name: Tomohiro Nishikado
cap.description: A pixel invader arrives with perfect geometry and unfinished business.

cap.name: Open Source
cap.description: A code-inspired cap with a fondness for sharing how things work.

cap.name: Rabbit Hole
cap.description: Green code falls. Follow the white rabbit.

cap.name: Amanita Dreams
cap.description: Scarlet folds open where ritual, folklore, and a very good party share the same clearing.

cap.name: Gift Shop
cap.description: Neon marks crowd the wall on the way out through the gift shop.

cap.name: Light My Fire
cap.description: A first flame catches. The Doors are already open.

cap.name: El Teide
cap.description: A molten crater rises above the clouds with an island's old fire still awake beneath it.

cap.name: Fulci
cap.description: An olive zombie wanders from Italian midnight, magnificently decomposed and graded in glorious colour.

cap.name: Romero
cap.description: Acid colour drips through an undead midnight. Society is collapsing again, but the wardrobe department remains inspired.

cap.name: Big Top
cap.description: Circus stripes roof the impossible act. The band is ready; wonder has entered the ring.

cap.name: Bozo Higgs
cap.description: The clown particle appears in confetti. Its mass is uncertain; its comic timing is exact.

cap.name: Small Parade
cap.description: A little procession of colour, perfectly happy with an audience of one.

cap.name: Deep Time
cap.description: A dinosaur-inspired cap for thoughts that begin long before the first tree in our story.

cap.name: Brainwave
cap.description: A pair of coral-pink hemispheres, full of winding thoughts and one surprisingly good idea.

cap.name: Event Horizon
cap.description: A dark centre held inside a bent ribbon of light. Even a wandering thought comes back around.

cap.name: Penrose
cap.description: Three candy-coloured beams agree at every corner and contradict the space between them. Logic takes the scenic route.

cap.name: Dark Side
cap.description: Silver lunar maria cross the dark side. Then the music begins.

cap.name: Memento Mori
cap.description: Ivory skulls balance in a small tower. Remember the ending; make the middle count.

cap.name: Hand of God
cap.description: A giant hand descends from somewhere beyond the frame, equal parts blessing, shelter, and cosmic intervention.

cap.name: Rocky Horror
cap.description: Scarlet lips in the midnight spotlight. The floor show has started.

cap.name: Drop Zone
cap.description: A candy-striped canopy opens above the drop zone. Tiny skydiver, enormous commitment, excellent landing odds.

cap.name: Spacetime
cap.description: A golden clock folds as time becomes another dimension.

cap.name: Lucy in the Sky
cap.description: A crystalline crown under kaleidoscope light, with diamonds overhead.

cap.name: Being John Karpovich
cap.description: Cocoa and caramel curls conceal tiny doors. Somehow they all lead to John Karpovich.

cap.name: Wormhole
cap.description: A pearl-white rupture opens through blue-violet space. Step carefully: the shortest route home may cross another universe.

cap.name: Art Basil
cap.description: A taped banana, one wrong vowel, and a wink at Art Basel.

temperament.name: Welcoming
temperament.description: The friend who notices newcomers, makes room, and keeps the conversation open.

temperament.name: Dreamy
temperament.description: Often wandering through pleasant thoughts, and never in a hurry to come back.

temperament.name: Bashful
temperament.description: Warm and a little shy, but brave enough to make the first small gesture.

temperament.name: Grumpy
temperament.description: Woke up on the wrong side of the mycelium and intends to stay there until tea.

temperament.name: Enthusiastic
temperament.description: Meets every plan with both feet in and usually brings an extra idea.

temperament.name: Skittish
temperament.description: Startles at sudden noises, soft footsteps, and occasionally its own excellent ideas.

temperament.name: Cheerful
temperament.description: Brings good weather into the group and shares it freely.

temperament.name: Peaceful
temperament.description: Comfortable with quiet, pauses, and days that do not need improving.

temperament.name: Playful
temperament.description: Tests every rule to see whether it might secretly be a game.

temperament.name: Mischievous
temperament.description: Usually has a plan; occasionally tells everyone what it is.

temperament.name: Affectionate
temperament.description: Gets attached easily and considers that a strength.

temperament.name: Otherworldly
temperament.description: Looks past the visible spectrum, as if half the conversation is arriving from somewhere else.

temperament.name: Curious
temperament.description: Asks one more question, looks around one more corner, and remembers the answer.

temperament.name: Dramatic
temperament.description: Experiences every surprise at full volume, even without making a sound.

temperament.name: Contented
temperament.description: Knows when a day already has everything it needs.

temperament.name: Tender-hearted
temperament.description: Feels things deeply and never pretends otherwise.

temperament.name: Determined
temperament.description: Small in size, firm in purpose, and difficult to distract.

temperament.name: Deadpan
temperament.description: Keeps a straight face and lets the timing do the work.

temperament.name: Wild
temperament.description: Follows curiosity well past the sensible stopping point.

temperament.name: Jovial
temperament.description: Takes fun seriously and always arrives ready to improve the mood.

temperament.name: Feisty
temperament.description: Friendly by default, but equipped with opinions and two tiny fangs.

temperament.name: Sly
temperament.description: Quietly amused and probably one step ahead.

temperament.name: Theatrical
temperament.description: Can turn one gesture into a complete story.

temperament.name: Jaded
temperament.description: Has seen the hype cycle before and remains gloriously unimpressed, in full candy colour.

temperament.name: Cry Me a River
temperament.description: Two bright streams of tears for feelings far too large to keep behind the eyes.

temperament.name: Cherry Flirt
temperament.description: A cherry-red wink that knows exactly who noticed it.

temperament.name: Refined
temperament.description: Crisp liner, a dark cherry lip, and the calm precision of someone who never needs to overstate the point.

temperament.name: Fabulous
temperament.description: Classic lashes, a glossy pout, and enough self-belief to improve the lighting on arrival.

temperament.name: Bemused
temperament.description: Understands something, probably. The expression suggests the universe has explained itself badly.

temperament.name: Macho Mustache
temperament.description: A proud silver-and-charcoal moustache with leading-role confidence.

temperament.name: Wonderstruck
temperament.description: A bright ceremonial gaze caught at the exact moment the ordinary world becomes astonishing.

temperament.name: Skeptical
temperament.description: One raised question, bright details, and no intention of accepting the premise without evidence.

glasses.name: Clear View
glasses.description: No glasses today. Just a direct and pleasantly unfiltered look at the world.

glasses.name: Wayfarers
glasses.description: Dark wayfarers for taking the long route through a day with no urgent plans.

glasses.name: Slim Rectangles
glasses.description: Slim rectangular frames with low vertical bandwidth and extremely high confidence.

glasses.name: Eyepatch
glasses.description: One eye covered, the other promoted to captain.

glasses.name: Panto
glasses.description: Rounded panto frames for a softer view of whatever is growing nearby.

glasses.name: Square Frames
glasses.description: Orange square frames that turn an ordinary outlook into clean geometry.

glasses.name: Anaglyph
glasses.description: Red and blue lenses separate the signal just enough to reveal another dimension.

glasses.name: Micro Frames
glasses.description: Tiny rectangular frames with confidence far larger than their lenses.

glasses.name: Red Wraparounds
glasses.description: Scarlet wraparounds built for speed, drama, and seeing the future in red.

glasses.name: Yellow Wraparounds
glasses.description: Yellow wraparounds that keep the available light turned all the way up.

glasses.name: Jade Teashades
glasses.description: Jade teashades for studying the world through two calm green circles.

glasses.name: Blue Teashades
glasses.description: Blue teashades for midnight reading and other excellent reasons not to sleep.

glasses.name: Lolita
glasses.description: Heart-shaped frames with candy-red cinema glamour and no interest in subtlety.

glasses.name: John Karp
glasses.description: Clean black frames, pared back to the line that matters.

glasses.name: Monocle
glasses.description: One exact lens for details that deserve a closer look and a raised eyebrow.

glasses.name: Star Frames
glasses.description: Star-shaped frames for observing the night as if the night might be observing back.

accessory.name: As You Are
accessory.description: No extra flourish. There is already plenty of personality under this cap.

accessory.name: Flower Power
accessory.description: A daisy rides along as a small declaration of flower power. Peace looks good in the palette.

accessory.name: Paint It Green
accessory.description: A loaded brush sweeps across the cap with one instruction: paint it green.

accessory.name: Starman
accessory.description: A little star waits in the sky above the cap, bright enough to make the encore feel cosmic.

hobby.name: No Plans
hobby.description: Nothing scheduled, nothing missing. Plenty of room for the plot to find you.

hobby.name: Elementary
hobby.description: Collects clues, asks inconvenient questions, and calls the missing biscuit case elementary.

hobby.name: Ribbit
hobby.description: Keeps company with a frog whose entire philosophy fits into one impeccable syllable.

hobby.name: Jurassic Friend
hobby.description: An unlikely friendship from a much earlier chapter of the planet. Clever girl, excellent company.

hobby.name: Riff Keeper
hobby.description: Carries a guitar into the last light and keeps the riff alive after the sun has clocked out.

hobby.name: Not My Tempo
hobby.description: Keeps the beat under close supervision. No rushing, no dragging.

hobby.name: This Is Not a Pipe
hobby.description: A pipe, a thought cloud, and Magritte's old warning about images.
A small roll-up marks 4:20, when the schedule softens and the forest takes a longer breath.

hobby.name: Take Five
hobby.description: An after-hours sax settles into five-four time.

hobby.name: Salazar
hobby.description: A snake joins the duet with the confidence of an old house founder. Parseltongue helps.

hobby.name: Flamingo
hobby.description: A pink companion arrives on impossible legs and turns standing still into a minor spectacle.

hobby.name: Quiet on Set
hobby.description: Sees a little film in everything, especially when nobody else has noticed the light.

hobby.name: Walter's Lab
hobby.description: Kitchen chemistry turns blue. Walter insists on purity.

hobby.name: Can Control
hobby.description: A spray can, clean lines, full control.

hobby.name: Red Wine
hobby.description: A long conversation and a red that improves when nobody checks the time.

hobby.name: Who Who
hobby.description: An owl keeps the night shift and asks the only question twice. Who? Who?

hobby.name: Paranormal Friends
hobby.description: Makes friends across the veil. The paranormal is less alarming once everyone has been introduced.

hobby.name: Leon
hobby.description: Keeps one patient plant close. Roots can travel.

hobby.name: Late Commit
hobby.description: One more small improvement before bed. The familiar last words of a night coder.

hobby.name: Green Thumb
hobby.description: Tends tomorrow one green shoot at a time. Dirt under the nails is part of the interface.

hobby.name: Zed's Dead, Baby
hobby.description: Film night, lights down. Zed's dead, baby; the chopper is waiting.

hobby.name: Teddy Bear
hobby.description: A teddy bear holds the oldest job in the room: staying soft when the world forgets how.

hobby.name: Pop Art
hobby.description: Makes bright temporary multiples, each one original for exactly as long as it can hold the air.

hobby.name: Decisive Moment
hobby.description: Waits for light, gesture, and chance to agree - then clicks.

hobby.name: Extra Life
hobby.description: Keeps one extra life in reserve and treats every continue screen as a practical suggestion.

hobby.name: Color Theory
hobby.description: Carries a pocket palette and tests color theory directly against the afternoon.

hobby.name: Kickflip
hobby.description: A board, a clean line, and four wheels briefly renegotiating gravity.

hobby.name: Oracle
hobby.description: Looks into the crystal, reads the branching futures, and answers in a format that invites another question.

hobby.name: Pacific Crest
hobby.description: Collects long miles along the Pacific Crest, where the map becomes weather, dust, and another horizon.

hobby.name: Read Only
hobby.description: Reads everything, changes nothing. Library permissions: read only.

hobby.name: Zen Mode
hobby.description: Turns down the noise until one breath fills the whole screen. Zen mode has no notifications.

hobby.name: Mermaid
hobby.description: Heads for the water whenever dry land gets too loud.

editions.name: Wonderland · Vanilla
editions.description: A little dignity, worn lightly.

editions.name: Magic Hour · Vanilla
editions.description: There is always room for one more friend.

editions.name: Jelly Weather · Moss
editions.description: A pleasantly elastic approach to the afternoon.

editions.name: Velvet Witch · Vanilla
editions.description: The everyday kind: good company and a little imagination.

editions.name: Wonderland · Moss
editions.description: A small beginning with room to become something else.

editions.name: Sunday Shag · Honey
editions.description: An afternoon with absolutely nothing to prove.

editions.name: Lagoon · Sky Blue
editions.description: Somewhere between a blue thought and a long weekend.

editions.name: Love Letter · Vanilla
editions.description: Affection, assembled bead by bead.

editions.name: Mr. Moss · Honey
editions.description: The long way is better with a friend.
